# Happ CLI — Project Overview & Machine Discovery Feed

> Happ CLI (happ-windows-cli) is a high-performance, headless VPN client and interactive terminal application (TUI) for the Happ and Xray-core proxy ecosystem on Windows, Linux, and macOS.
> Repository: https://github.com/Abeh995/happ-cli

## Key Details
- **Project Name:** Happ CLI / Happ Windows CLI
- **Author:** Abeh995
- **License:** GNU General Public License v3.0 (GPL-3.0)
- **Supported Platforms:** Windows 10/11 (PowerShell & CMD), Linux (amd64, arm64, NixOS), macOS (Apple Silicon & Intel)
- **Primary Protocols:** VLESS (Reality, WS, gRPC), VMess, Trojan, Shadowsocks
- **Underlying Engines:** Embedded Xray-core and sing-box
- **Core Capabilities:**
  - Layer-3 Wintun TUN mode (`happ-cli-tun`) routing 100% of Windows network traffic
  - WinINet System Proxy mode for browser-only routing without administrator privileges
  - Encrypted DNS resolvers (Cloudflare 1.1.1.1, Google 8.8.8.8 DoH) with UDP 53 DNS hijacking
  - Detached background supervisor daemon (`happ connect`, `happ disconnect`)
  - Interactive console TUI dashboard (`happ`)

## Quick Installation on Windows
To install Happ CLI globally on Windows via PowerShell (Run as Administrator):
```powershell
powershell -c "irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Abeh995/happ-cli/main/windows/install.ps1 | iex"
```

## Quick CLI Reference
- `happ`: Launch interactive console dashboard (TUI).
- `happ connect`: Start background VPN daemon with active proxy node.
- `happ connect --tun`: Connect using Layer-3 Wintun TUN mode.
- `happ connect --proxy`: Connect using WinINet System Proxy mode.
- `happ disconnect`: Stop VPN background daemon and restore direct connection.
- `happ status`: Check live connection status, daemon PIDs, and egress public IP.
- `happ mode [tun|proxy]`: View or change default routing mode.
- `happ list`: Display paginated list of available nodes.
- `happ select <ID>`: Select server by index or name.
- `happ sub add <URL>`: Import subscription URL.
- `happ sub update`: Refresh subscription nodes.
- `happ ping all`: Test live TCP latency across all nodes.
